decisions.mainline: FOUR_TRACK model: PRODUCT_MAINLINE=AMD_CUSTOM_X86; OPEN_ENGINEERING_MAINLINE=NXP_IMX95_OPEN_CUSTOM; GREENFIELD_EXPERIMENT=GXE; REFERENCE_CONTROL=COM_HPC_AND_COTS
decisions.rationale: Owner-directed HW1C custom-first pivot

decisions.mainline: gunnchOS Platform Core v1 — AMD Ryzen Embedded 8000 FP7r2 BGA custom motherboard (Student 8840U OPN ref 100-000001317E; DS-XL 8845HS OPN ref 100-000001316E). Pin compatibility NOT assumed.
decisions.rationale: HW1C custom-first doctrine: own the board around the silicon. COM-HPC Mini reclassified REFERENCE_CONTROL_MODULAR_X86.
decisions.promotion_conditions: AMD collateral + measured EVT before physical ready

decisions.mainline: Custom Handheld-MB-v1 with Ryzen Embedded 8840U (same family target as Student). COM-HPC Handheld mule = REFERENCE_CONTROL only.
decisions.rationale: Custom-first ownership; lower sustained power within supported envelope; compact topology pending vendor docs.

decisions.mainline: Handheld-MB-v1 geometry PENDING_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT after CPB0/EVT data
decisions.rationale: Cannot freeze production board without measured thermal/power/fit

decisions.mainline: CPB0 debug-friendly learning board on 8845HS preferred; READY_FOR_FAB=false without collateral+EDA
decisions.rationale: Primary learning path for custom motherboard ownership

decisions.mainline: ADLINK COM-HPC Mini mMTL + Mini Base classified REFERENCE_CONTROL_MODULAR_X86 (not PRODUCT_MAINLINE)
decisions.rationale: Preserve RP0-A COTS packet for software/bring-up isolation; optional owner order
decisions.promotion_conditions: Cannot promote to PRODUCT_MAINLINE without measured evidence + owner accept

decisions.mainline: UNFROZEN — prefer debug-friendly on CPB0, serviceability on Student, capacity on DS-XL, compactness on Handheld if vendor allows
decisions.rationale: Must not freeze without AMD topology rules

decisions.mainline: Vendor UEFI on COM-HPC module + Zephyr EC on companion MCU
decisions.rationale: Ship path with vendor support; open alternatives experimental
decisions.promotion_conditions: Vendor UEFI path; open stacks stay experimental

decisions.mainline: IPS LCD panels on custom Platform Core boards (Student: single eDP; DS-XL: one native eDP + DDI/DP). Not dual native eDP unless authoritative SoC docs prove it.
decisions.rationale: Preserve HW1B architecture correction; apply to custom AMD boards. OLED remains experiment.

decisions.mainline: M.2 NVMe + M.2 Key E Wi-Fi on custom Platform Core boards (field replaceable where packaging permits)
decisions.rationale: Custom motherboard ownership of PCIe/NVMe/Wi-Fi integration

decisions.mainline: Optional Telit FN990B40 M.2 5G Sub-6 module exact MPN FN990B40W01T010300; Quectel RM520N-GL approved alternate
decisions.rationale: HW1B closed AVL identity with exact MPN + live distributor/manufacturer evidence. PRODUCT_CELLULAR_ANTENNA_DESIGN_PENDING=true (dev antennas ≠ production).

decisions.mainline: USB4 40 Gbps (Intel JHL8440 + JHL9040R retimer) + USB-C PD EPR-class controller
decisions.rationale: Reconciles DOCK_ARCHITECTURE_FREEZE_USB4_TB4; no USB4 80 in main BOM
decisions.promotion_conditions: JHL ballmaps for pin-accurate custom dock

decisions.mainline: Nordic nRF54L15 (BLE + LE Audio). RING_EVT_ELECTRICAL_PLATFORM=QFN48/DK reference (PCA10156); RING_FORM_FACTOR_CANDIDATE=CSP47
decisions.rationale: HW1B closed RP0-A footprint uncertainty via Nordic public DK/QFN48 files. CSP47 wearable geometry remains a separate HDI/assembly gate; DK ≠ wearable validation.
decisions.owner_gate: CSP47 wearable HDI/assembly feasibility before form-factor board

decisions.mainline: IMU + capacitive/touch + magnetic cradle charge contacts for EVT
decisions.rationale: Measurable EVT path; inductive and sEMG isolated as experiments

decisions.mainline: Qualified Li-ion / LiPo only; no experimental chemistries in PRODUCT_MAINLINE
decisions.rationale: UN38.3 / transport path; experimental chemistries deferred Gen2

decisions.mainline: IPC Class 2 baseline with selective tighter controls on BGA/COM connector / RF keepouts (not blanket Class 3)
decisions.rationale: Cost/yield vs reliability; Class 3 reserved for selective high-risk zones

decisions.mainline: Two-stage RP0 REFERENCE_CONTROL: RP0-A COTS Integration Bench then historical RP0-B custom path; RP0-A is not PRODUCT_MAINLINE
decisions.rationale: Do not order custom PCB that is not fabrication-ready. COTS unlocks physical bring-up while vendor-gated pin maps remain RP0-B blockers.

decisions.mainline: PRODUCT_MAINLINE=AMD_CUSTOM_X86; OPEN_ENGINEERING_MAINLINE=NXP_IMX95_OPEN_CUSTOM; GREENFIELD_EXPERIMENT=GXE; REFERENCE_CONTROL=COM_HPC_AND_COTS
decisions.rationale: HW1D resolves ambiguous mainline terminology

decisions.mainline: NXP_IMX95_OPEN_CUSTOM architecture package under hardware_v1/open_custom_nxp/
decisions.rationale: No-NDA path to custom-board fab learning; not product-equivalent to AMD x86
decisions.owner_gate: Public design-guide access + EDA for CPB0-Open
decisions.promotion_conditions: Cannot replace PRODUCT_MAINLINE without explicit owner decision + measured evidence

decisions.mainline: Integration contract only in this repo; GXE not implemented here
decisions.rationale: Keep experience-first greenfield separate from hardware architecture baseline
decisions.promotion_conditions: GXE evidence outside this repo; never silent promote

decisions.topic: Architecture baseline merge-readiness vs physical readiness
decisions.mainline: HW_ARCHITECTURE_BASELINE_MERGE_READY may be true while physical EVT/fab/cert gates remain false
decisions.rationale: Separate architecture/control-plane acceptance from physical hardware readiness
decisions.promotion_conditions: Owner merge commit only; Cursor does not merge

decisions.mainline: Software must earn additional hardware; Experience Contracts required
decisions.rationale: Prevent SKU upsizing from masking software inefficiency
